name: Repair Workshop
description:
Diagnosis and repair share a technician pool.

What is the trade-off between break cover and an extra technician?

Starting assumptions
• Two hours of requests; 20% have higher queue priority.
• Diagnosis and repair share two technicians, reduced to one from minute 50 to 70.
• Durations are illustrative; parts availability and specific repair procedures are excluded.

Synthetic teaching models. Timings, demand and staffing are illustrative; layout does not add travel time.
